name: topology_complete_plan
description: Mark an entire workflow DAG plan as completed. Records final completion timestamp, executive summary, and output deliverables/artifacts, automatically finalizing any remaining active or pending tasks.

planId.description: Plan ID to mark completed (defaults to currently active plan)

summary.description: Executive wrap-up summary of work accomplished, verification status, and deliverables

artifacts.description: Output artifacts, files, documentation, or deliverables generated by this plan

autoCompleteNodes.description: Whether to auto-mark any unfinished nodes in the graph as completed
